reliability_note: Re-encoding destroys byte fidelity, so it cannot store arbitrary binaries. Ticket-gated downloads and ad-injected players make unattended fetch fragile. Activity requirement is unquantified on the pages read.

extras.quota_verbatim: 'Unlimited Storage — Upload as many Videos as you wish. Active files will be saved'.
extras.limits_verbatim: Video formats only; files are encoded/re-encoded on ingest (lossy for anything not already a video). 'Active files' only are kept — inactive files are purged. Downloads require a generated ticket.
extras.egress_verbatim: No stated bandwidth cap; 'unlimited upload/download speed' claimed. Ad-monetised, so egress is the product.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Free accounts x unlimited storage x unlimited files. Video-only in practice (it is a streaming host); the useful play is media/checkpoint shards, not raw datasets.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Documented API at https://streamtape.com/api with account info, download ticket, get download link, file info and upload endpoints. Widely integrated into upload bots.
extras.agent_focus: big anonymous file hosts, with mandatory Buzzheavier deep dive on its published free-tier-stacking architecture
